sections.title: About Memevores
sections.content: MEMEVORES is a creator hub for meme clips, sounds, templates, and edit assets. Everything is organized to help you find and use content quickly in your own videos and edits.

sections.title: How it works
sections.content: Whenever media is uploaded to the Telegram channel, it is automatically detected and listed here, so users can easily browse and find the clips, audio, templates, and other content they need.
